descriptions.LZA-G-CT-1: Configures Control Tower for setting up and governing a secure multi-account AWS environment

descriptions.LZA-LOG-1: Creates centralized S3 bucket to store logs for unified and secure logging management

descriptions.LZA-LOG-3: Creates S3 bucket to store S3 access logs
descriptions.LZA-LOG-4: Configures the S3 logs retention period of 365 days and expiration of 1000 days
descriptions.LZA-SEC-Config-33: Creates attach EC2 instance profile custom config rules, and custom remediation for attaching profile to instance
descriptions.LZA-SEC-Config-34: Creates ELB logging enabled custom config rules, and custom remediation for enabling logging
descriptions.LZA-SEC-SecHub-2: Configures AWS Foundational Security Best Practices v1.0.0 (FSBP) standard developed by AWS and industry professionals, FSBP is a compilation of best practices for organizations regardless of sector or size
descriptions.LZA-SEC-SecHub-3: Configures CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 standard for supporting the requirements of CIS Security Software Certification
descriptions.LZA-SEC-SecHub-4: Configures NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 in Security Hub standard for supporting the federal agencies or organizations that work with federal agencies or federal information systems

descriptions.LZA-SEC-GD-3: Configures EKS Protection to detect potential security risks in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) clusters in the AWS environment
descriptions.LZA-SEC-GD-4: Configures exporting generated GuardDuty findings to Amazon S3 buckets with the export frequency of 6 hours (default)
descriptions.LZA-SEC-MACIE-2: Delegates the Amazon Macie administration to the audit account, register all member accounts with delegated administrator
descriptions.LZA-SEC-MACIE-3: Configures Amazon Macie for publishing sensitive data findings to SecurityHub
descriptions.LZA-SEC-MACIE-4: Configures Macie publish updated policy findings with the frequency of 15 minutes

descriptions.LZA-SEC-SNS-4: Creates SNS topic with suffix 'SecurityMedium' and subscriptions with email address

descriptions.LZA-SEC-DPPE-5: Configures organization backup policy to deploy organization-wide backup plans
descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-1: Configures account password policy to allow users to change password

descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-4: Configures account password policy to require at least one lowercase letter from the Latin alphabet (a-z)
descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-5: Configures account password policy to require at least one number
descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-6: Configures account password policy to require at least one non-alphanumeric character ( ( ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - = [ ] {} | ' ))
descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-7: Configures account password policy to require minimum password length of 14
descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-8: Configures account password policy to require password reuse prevention of 24 passwords
descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-PW-9: Configures account password policy to require password expiration age of 90 days

descriptions.LZA-SEC-IAM-POL-2: Creates default Systems Manager S3 policy

descriptions.LZA-SEC-CRY-2: Configures server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) or Customer Managed Key KMS Key.
descriptions.LZA-SEC-CWL-1: Configures CloudWatch logs retention to 365 days
descriptions.LZA-SEC-CWL-2: Configures dynamic partitioning for CloudWatch Logs
descriptions.LZA-SEC-CWL-3: Configures subscription filters for CloudWatch logs
descriptions.LZA-SEC-CWL-4: Configures customer-managed KMS Key (CMK) to encrypt CloudWatch logs
descriptions.LZA-NET-ARC-1: Shared VPC Model: Deploys a dedicated VPC with established  connectivity for each corresponding workload account (Dev, Test, Prod)
descriptions.LZA-NET-ARC-2: Hub-and-Spoke VPC Model: Deploys resources across various VPCs designed to host different workloads, where data or resource access is governed by centralized "hub" infrastructure
descriptions.LZA-NET-ARC-3: Centralized VPC Endpoints: Provides a centralized VPC with endpoints reachable via Transit Gateway
descriptions.LZA-NET-SEC-1: East-West Inspection: Regional-based firewall inspection of internal system traffic traversing between Transit Gateways
descriptions.LZA-NET-SEC-2: North-South Inspection: Regional based firewall inspection for traffic entering or leaving the environment to or from the internet
descriptions.LZA-NET-SEC-3: Centralized Inspection: Regional based firewall inspection of traffic traversing Transit Gateway for both North-South and East-West
descriptions.LZA-NET-SEC-4: Implements inspection for stateful rules via AWS Network Firewall
descriptions.LZA-NET-SEC-5: Implements native AWS layer 3 and 4 controls (Security Groups and Network Access Control Lists (NACLS))

descriptions.LZA-NET-LOG-2: Sends VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs
descriptions.LZA-NET-LOG-3: Sends VPC Flow Logs to Amazon S3
descriptions.LZA-NET-LOG-4: Enables VPC Flow Logs on VPCs provisioned by LZA

descriptions.LZA-NET-LOG-7: Forwards Network Firewall Logs to CloudWatch Logs

descriptions.LZA-RAM-2: Configures IPAM resource sharing to applicable Organization Units and accounts
